Describe the sampled diet dataset

Source: R/dv_explore.R
dv_summary.Rd

A quick overview of sample structure, computed before any figure: how many stomachs and prey records each predator contributes, how many distinct prey taxa were seen, and the mean number of prey records per stomach. Optionally broken down by a covariate.

Usage

dv_summary(prep, by = NULL, rank = NULL)

Arguments

prep

A dietview_prep from dv_prepare().

by

Optional covariate column to break the summary down by.

rank

Optional rank (one of prep$ranks, e.g. "family") at which n_taxa is counted. NULL (default) uses the finest resolved label.

Value

A data.frame with one row per predator (and per by level), with n_stomachs, n_records, n_taxa, records_per_stomach, and, when a weight column is declared, total_weight.

Details

By default (rank = NULL) a taxon is the finest resolved label of each record, which mixes ranks: a stomach with Themisto libellula and "Amphipoda" counts two taxa although Themisto is an amphipod, so n_taxa overstates richness, more so as digestion advances. Give rank to count taxa at one stated rank instead, unidentified records excluded.

Note that a long prey-record table represents only non-empty stomachs, so this function cannot report a vacuity (percent-empty) index; that must be computed upstream from the full sampling frame.

Examples

# the standard set-up: public ICES data, non-food items and nematodes dropped
phylum <- ices_lineage$phylum[match(ices_diet$prey_aphia_id, ices_lineage$prey_aphia_id)]
dat <- ices_diet[ices_diet$item_type != "non_food" & !phylum %in% "Nematoda", ]
spec <- dv_spec(
  predator       = "predator_common",
  predator_latin = "predator_latin",
  stomach        = "stomach_id",
  prey_id        = "prey_aphia_id",
  prey_name      = "prey_name",
  weight         = "prey_weight_g",
  count          = "prey_count",
  digestion      = "digestion_label",
  covariates     = c("region", "year", "quarter")
)
prep <- dv_prepare(dat, spec, taxonomy = "table", lineage = ices_lineage,
                   verbose = FALSE)
dv_summary(prep)
